title: Octave can start a server of any change to main with one command
description: Serves Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need.". Octave #190. Octave always has a working server to build and test against (D-115).
acceptanceCriteria: Every merge to main publishes a server Octave's CI can start with one documented command, by commit or as the newest.

It comes with test films and shows covering every format and track M1 must play (as they are, a container to convert, a re-encode, several audio languages, text and image subtitles, HDR), on both stores, and a test account.
It carries the contract it serves (JS-183) once that exists.
Until the cutover it also answers the Jellyfin routes Octave uses today; after it, `jellyfin-final` stays available for good.
Octave's CI pulls it with no personal credential (today's images are not anonymously pullable).
